scenario: 4. Thigh lot, product 6 hours above 40°F after a storm outage
note: Normal route. Raw poultry is cooked by the end user.
why: Product exceeded the 2-hour limit above 40°F. Two hours is FSIS consumer guidance; the critical limit in the plant's HACCP plan (9 CFR 417.2) governs. Cooking kills Salmonella, but it does not address toxins from other bacteria or lost HACCP control. The plant's process authority makes the final call.
